in_sanskrit.name: Ramki
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God in heart
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ramki एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram means 'God' and Ki means 'residing in heart'. So, Ramki means 'God in heart'.

in_hindi.name: Ramki
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God in heart
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ramki एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram means 'God' and Ki means 'residing in heart'. So, Ramki means 'God in heart'.

in_telugu.name: Ramki
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God in heart
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ramki ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Ram means 'God' and Ki means 'residing in heart'. So, Ramki means 'God in heart'.

in_marathi.name: Ramki
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Ki means 'residing in heart'. So, Ramki means 'God in heart'.

in_bengali.name: Ramki
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God in heart
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramki একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram means 'God' and Ki means 'residing in heart'. So, Ramki means 'God in heart'.
